title: Meet the Most Spoiled 16-Year-Old Ever
description:
On March 17th, 2024. Multiple calls were placed regarding a vehicle they saw on the road that was heavily damaged & without a front tire. When the officers conducted the traffic stop, they come to find out that it was a HIGHLY intoxicated 16-year-old girl who was behind the wheel. She was very belligerent and refused to listen to reason, so much so that she even assaulted an officer.
